name: [SKY CARROT] 🐰 Rabbit Simulator 2
desc:
📜 QUEST: Unlock the secret Sky Carrot in the game!

🐦 Use the code "newcarrot" for 25 Carrot boost!

🐇 Become a cute little bunny in the friendly forest and hop like you have never hopped before!

🥕 Eat your carrots to grow big and strong!

✂️ Fight other players by slashing with your shining red claws of doom!

🥚 Destroy blocks around the map to discover and collect easter eggs!

💯 Rebirth to become even stronger!

Game is compatible with PC, XBOX, Mobile and Tablet!
